'''Frorral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], she was the wilderness fighting expert of the [[Katarn Commandos]], a New Republic [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit lead by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]]. Frrorral was also the one to name the unit, as a reference to the Kashykk [[Katarn/Legends|predator]] of the same name.<ref name="HttES" />

==History==
When New Republic forces [[Battle of Hettsk|battled]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Hettsk]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref>The Essential Atlas establishes [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn's early raids]] as between 44:4:15 and 44:6:29 on the [[Great ReSynchronization]] calendar</ref> two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were shot down over an uninhabited jungle on the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] world. The New Republic fled, but Page and five of his commandos, including Frorral, were inserted onto the planet's surface to [[Mission to Hettsk|retrieve]] [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Greni]] and her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] [[Bross]], two members of [[Gold Squadron (New Republic)|Gold Squadron]]. Imperial troops found the pilots in the jungle shortly before nightfall, but made camp for the night rather than take them back to base in darkness. Page watched the Imperials and their [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]] through a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] and decided to feign surrender in order to better commandeer the vehicle. He, Frorral, and fellow commando [[Idow]] approached the transport and announced their surrender to the two troopers standing guard outside of the vehicle, who in turn opened its hatch to fetch their backup. Frorral battered the two troopers as Page lobbed a grenade at the stormtroopers emerging from the transport. Idow retrieved the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] of one of the downed troops and began firing. Commandos [[Vandro]] and [[Lilla Dade]], who had hidden themselves earlier, rushed into the clearing. Vandro's [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] disabled the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines of the transport as it the vehicle turned to flee, while Frorral boarded the vehicle and neutralized the transport's two Imperial pilots. The two X-wing pilots were retrieved.<ref name="CM" />
